ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Graph description: The figure has four labeled Lewis structures: Methanol shows one carbon connected to three hydrogens and connected to an oxygen with lone-pair electrons, and the oxygen is then connected to hydrogen, meaning it contains an O-H group; Pentane shows five carbons connected in a chain, containing only C-C and C-H bonds; Acetone shows a three-carbon structure, with the middle carbon forming a C=O carbonyl group with oxygen; Ether shows two carbons connected through an oxygen with lone-pair electrons, that is, a C-O-C structure. Reasoning: Compare polarity by functional group. Pentane has only a hydrocarbon chain and is basically nonpolar; Ether has C-O-C bonds and has moderate polarity; Acetone has a C=O carbonyl group and stronger polarity; Methanol has an O-H group and the molecule is very small, so it can interact strongly with polar solvents, and therefore is the most polar among these four. The question states that a polar solvent is used and asks which molecule will travel the farthest; according to the one with the highest compatibility with the polar solvent traveling the farthest, Methanol should be chosen.

raw_record.question_text: Among the four molecules shown in the Lewis structures, which molecule would travel the farthest in a paper chromatography experiment using a polar solvent?

method.method_draft: Identify the functional groups in the image, then compare their polarity: pentane is nonpolar, ether is moderately polar, acetone is polar due to C=O, and methanol is very polar because it has an O-H group and only one carbon. Since the text specifies a polar solvent and asks which travels farthest, choose the molecule most compatible with the polar solvent: methanol.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有四个标注的 Lewis 结构：Methanol 显示一个碳连接三个氢并连接到带孤对电子的氧，氧再连接氢，即含有 O-H 基团；Pentane 显示五个碳连成链，只含 C-C 和 C-H 键；Acetone 显示三个碳结构，中间碳与氧形成 C=O 羰基；Ether 显示两个碳通过一个带孤对电子的氧相连，即 C-O-C 结构。

推理：按官能团比较极性，Pentane 只有烃链，基本非极性；Ether 有 C-O-C 键，具有中等极性；Acetone 有 C=O 羰基，较强极性；Methanol 有 O-H 基团且分子很小，可以与极性溶剂强烈相互作用，因此在这四者中最极性。题目说明使用极性溶剂，并问哪种分子会走得最远；按与极性溶剂相容性最高者走得最远，应选择 Methanol。
